captions.detailed: An independent front double-wishbone suspension assembly featuring a dark grey fixed subframe block. It includes upper and lower triangular wishbone links connected via pivots to the subframe. A vertical steering knuckle links the outer ends of the wishbones, which in turn supports a light grey cylindrical wheel hub assembly. The wishbones pivot vertically relative to the subframe, the knuckle pivots to allow steering, and the wheel hub is designed for continuous rotation.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of an independent front double-wishbone axle assembly in CadQuery. The model must include a fixed dark grey subframe, pivoting upper and lower triangular wishbone links, a steering knuckle connecting their outer ends, and a rotatable light grey wheel hub on the knuckle spindle.
captions.factory: Create a subframe part using combined box primitives. Build the upper and lower wishbone parts by constructing triangular tubular structures with cylinders and rods. Model the steering knuckle with a vertical block, brackets at the ends, and a spindle cylinder. Create the wheel hub as a multi-stage cylinder. Define revolute joints for the inner wishbone pivots, revolute joints for the knuckle-to-wishbone connections, and a continuous rotation joint for the wheel hub.
